summary.discrepancy_explanation: Phase 4 reported 14 normal drains based on raw unreviewed drainage_catalog.json counts. Phase 3 reported 6 normal drains based on human-reviewed drainage_annotations_reviewed.json where 8 images originally labeled NORMAL_DRAIN were reclassified into blocked_drain or damaged_drain. In addition, 4 exact duplicate files inflate the raw file count.
